hero.title:
Ask a Question.
Get a Cited Report.
hero.description: HABOS delegates deep research to Perplexity AI, refines the question with clarifying prompts, and delivers a structured executive summary — then embeds everything into your Brain for future retrieval.

intro: Speak a question into your phone — HABOS auto-classifies it as a research intent and kicks off a deep investigation. Before running expensive research, the AI asks two targeted clarifying questions to narrow scope. Then Perplexity's sonar-pro model runs asynchronously, delivering a structured executive summary with key findings, citations, and follow-up questions. The completed research is chunked and embedded into your Brain, so it surfaces in future searches and AI conversations forever.

flow.label: How it works
flow.userQuestion: What's the competitive landscape for AI scheduling tools in field service?
flow.clarifyIntro: Before I research, two quick questions:
flow.clarifyQ1: Are you focused on US market or global?

result.label: Executive Summary
result.title: Competitive Landscape: AI Scheduling in Field Service
findings: ServiceTitan dominates enterprise with 42% market share, but their SMB offering is limited and overpriced at $89/user/mo.
Jobber and Housecall Pro compete on simplicity for SMB, but neither offers AI-native scheduling — both bolt on basic automation.
AI-first entrants (FieldPulse, Zuper) are gaining, growing 3x YoY in the $10-30/user range, signaling strong SMB demand for intelligent scheduling.

benefitCards.title: Voice to research
benefitCards.body: Say "research competitor pricing in our space" during a voice note. HABOS detects the research intent and kicks off the analysis automatically.

benefitCards.title: Always in your Brain
benefitCards.body: Completed research is chunked, embedded (512-dim vectors), and searchable forever. Ask about it months later — the Brain remembers.

benefitCards.title: Project-linked context
benefitCards.body: Link research to projects. Future research on the same topic pulls in prior findings for richer, non-repetitive analysis.

closing.title:
Other tools give you a search bar.
HABOS gives you a research team.
